title: #Dead2Me
description: Terri Harris was a loving mom who had no way of knowing that the man she'd met online had a dangerous history of crime, violence and abuse; he would go on to embark on a shocking murder spree that would leave him branded a psychopath.

title: #Dead2Me
description: Jennifer Poole's life tragically changed when she met Gavin Murphy; over the course of their relationship, Jennifer became subdued and distant; it was only after her brutal murder that her family uncovered Murphy's appalling treatment of Jennifer.

description: Tai O'Donnell was a talented musician, but his ambitions were cruelly cut short after he met Kamila Ahmad; Kamila managed to hide her violent past and keep control of Tai, and when he tried to leave, she stopped him in the most brutal way possible.

description: Iain Lawrence appears to be a successful businessman and a loving husband; however, his wife's death in a car accident reveals a different side to his life.

description: Michael Danaher writes a list of famous and wealthy targets, but his plans result in murder when he stabs historian and art dealer Adrian Greenwood to death.
